text_block_list.text: It's finally the day of the Takamatsunomiya Kinen. In the waiting room…

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Curren! I'm looking forward to running with you today!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Me too! Thanks for coming! ♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: As a hero, I'm always game for anything that'll lift everyone's spirits!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I actually don't really get what we're doing, but I posted like usual today!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, it was perfect! "Biko Pegasus—running for justice!" I love it! ♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Oh, that?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: "Her legs bring law wherever they may tread! Onward, Biko Pegasus! Across the arid wasteland!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: "Yahhh!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: "Area restored! Biko Pegasus returning to headquarters!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I made that based on episode seventy-four of Carrot Ranger, "Restore the Wasteland!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: The editing was sooo good!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: That's because I copied you! For example…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: "It's me, Curren. ♪ I'm gonna cast a spell on you! ♪"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: "One, two, three! ♪ Everyone fall in love with me! ♪"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: "You looove me, right? Ehehe! ♪"
Curren Chan ends up pushing through by pouring all her cuteness into her posts. She said she had a plan, but…

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I'd never really used any effects before… but now that I've tried editing, it's actually pretty fun!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Now I can play around and recreate scenes from Carrot Ranger! All my fellow hero fans really loved it too!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: …I'm glad you had fun with it, Biko. ♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I have no regrets! But… the real battle starts here!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: So come at me, Curren! Let's have a good race today!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna take you down head-on! In the name of everyone awaiting my victory!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Sooo, does that mean… you're calling me your enemy?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Oh! No, that's not what I meant!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hehe, it's okay. I get it. ♪ Plus, me being your enemy is fitting.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I can't see myself placing anywhere but first, after all. ♪ Sorry, but you're gonna have to take the loss this time.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: This win is mine!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Cause I'm dedicating this race to me!
